sourceTextResolution.resolution: The upright body is the support rod; horizontal end plates are the two parallel plane mirrors. The l glyph denotes their separation. The separate left bidirectional span is retained as the dimension. The rest light's upward and downward motion is unambiguously specified by the source prose; explicitly drawing it on one separate shared line is a justified clarity addition, not an invented source pixel trace.

The rightward arrow is velocity v perpendicular to the rod. The solid and two dashed apparatus positions represent one translating clock at consecutive lower/upper/lower light encounters. The full tick interval contains two equal light legs, not one leg.

Use semantic ink/muted/accent roles while retaining independent solid/dashed and arrow distinctions in neutral and print.
